newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks hit all-time highs, rate cut seen.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks hit all-time highs, rate cut seen.

text.p: CHANGE CHANGE

* Toronto stocks set record closing and intra-day highs on Friday * Investors eyeing Bank of Canada for possible rate cut next week * 88 million shares traded worth C$1.24 billion
Toronto stocks hit all-time highs on Friday, ending the week on a strong note as investors speculated about a possible interest rate cut next week.
The TSE 300 Composite Index rose 27.56 points to a record close of 5461.20, beating the old mark set on Monday.
The key index also hit an intra-day high of 5462.13. Just over 88 million shares were traded worth C$1.24 billion.

"I suspect they (Bank of Canada) will move rates lower. It clearly was not a very happy employment number this morning," said John Kellett, vice-president of Canadian equities for Royal Bank of Canada.
Canada's unemployment rate rose to an unexpectedly high 9.9 percent in September from 9.4 percent in August. Analysts had forecast a rate of 9.3 percent.
The poor jobs picture raised speculation that the Bank of Canada will cut short-term rates soon to boost the economy.

"Cut, cut, cut. Cut rates. It's quite clear you've got to cut rates," said Andrew Spence, senior economist at Deutsche Morgan erest-rate sensitive bank stocks led nine of 14 sub-groups higher. Advancing stocks outpaced declines 502 to 407, with 291 issues unchanged.
--- HOT STOCKS ---

* Among the high-flying banks, Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce closed up 1.20 to 55.10 after a 52-week high of 55.20. Bank of Montreal ended 1.30 higher at 39.75 after reaching a 52-week peak of 39.80.
* BCE Inc, Canada's biggest publicly-traded company, led net gainers. BCE jumped 1.60 to 59.70.
* Bre-X Minerals Ltd topped active shares, closing down 0.55 to 23.50 on 6.3 million shares. The junior gold miner is embroiled in an dispute with one of its Indonesian partners.
* Stampeder Exploration added 0.20 to 5.80 on 6.2 million shares after completing its takeover of Morgan Hydrocarbons.
